}}'''Hunting''' is a tier one [[technology]] that unlocks the hunting of wild animals (a.k.a. game). Hunting costs two [[stars]] and produces one [[population]]. 

The [[Bardur]] [[tribe]] starts with Hunting.

Hunting's branches in the technology tree are focused on forest management.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Midjiwan|title=DevBlog: Balance Pass 1|website=Steam|link=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/874390/view/4855419242367147448|date=20 Apr 2021|quote=...the Hunting branch now leans more towards Forest Management (Forest Defence, Grow Forest, Lumber Huts and Sawmills).}}</ref>

== Forest Magic ==
[[∑∫ỹriȱŋ]] has the '''Forest Magic''' technology instead of Hunting. Forest Magic unlocks the enchantment of wild animals into special [[Polytaur]] units. 

∑∫ỹriȱŋ starts with Forest Magic.
